value_semantics.applicable: the pair is instantiated and, unless the profile is the never-selectable diagnostic S4, it is gate-bearing

binding_status: BINDING_NORMATIVE_INPUT_NOT_AN_ILLUSTRATIVE_EXAMPLE. An independent implementation must be able to produce every applicable prompt byte from this registry alone, with no later wording, punctuation, whitespace, ordering, escaping or placeholder choice.

encoding_policy.line_ending: LF (U+000A) only; CR (U+000D) is prohibited in every registered string
encoding_policy.permitted_codepoints: U+0020 SPACE, U+000A LF, and the printable ASCII range U+0021 to U+007E; every other codepoint is rejected
encoding_policy.terminal_newline_policy: every question stem, option line and instruction sentence ends with exactly one LF; the answer cue carries no terminal newline and is the final registered byte of the prompt
encoding_policy.unicode_normalization: NFC; a renderer must reject any input that is not already NFC

future_pre_bank_token_distinctness_rule.on_failure: the role/profile/contrast combination becomes INELIGIBLE. Failure is never treated as a pass, never silently repaired, and never rescued.

future_pre_bank_token_distinctness_rule.why_not_now: no checkpoint or tokenizer may be accessed in this amendment, so byte distinctness is the only distinctness this round can establish

question_stem_templates.completeness_rule: exactly one template is registered for every (task stratum, operation family, composition depth) branch that can enter a gate-bearing cell; a missing branch is a fail-closed rejection, never a default
question_stem_templates.k5_and_k6_inherit: K5 and K6 register no stem of their own: a K5 or K6 contrast cluster renders a base item drawn from K1, K2 or K3 using that base item's registered stem branch, and varies only its own registered factor

registry_identity.canonical_serialisation: json.dumps(document, indent=1, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True) followed by one LF
registry_identity.self_hash_convention: registry_identity.registry_sha256 is computed over the canonical serialisation of this document with registry_identity.registry_sha256 set to null

entries.not_applicable_reason: S2 and S3 render neither an option label nor an option content, so the label-to-content separator has no referent. R-sep is structurally absent for them and is never rendered as a duplicate of R-base.

rp_wrapper.why_null_and_not_empty: an empty wrapper would assert that the positive reference needs no canonical qualification surface; the decision is open under OD2

separators.r_instr_separator_equals_r_base: R-instr holds the separator byte-identical to R-base because R-instr varies the instruction sentence only
separators.semantics: K6-SEP varies the separator between a DISPLAYED OPTION LABEL and its DISPLAYED OPTION CONTENT. A profile that renders neither has no referent for the factor.
